name: Évreux
text: Évreux (French pronunciation: [evʁø] ) is a commune in and the prefecture of the department of Eure, in the French region of Normandy.

depictions.name: Evreux
depictions.text: Évreux Evreux is a commune in the Eure department of France. During the medieval period, the city was home to many clergy and the gospel of the belief of "deliverance" under the Bellatores Dei's teachings.
